other_failure_modes.name: Potential unhandled string/categorical features
other_failure_modes.description: LightGBM requires string features to be explicitly converted to pandas 'category' dtype before training. By passing raw dataframes directly without categorical encoding or dtype conversion, the model will crash if any string columns exist in the dataset.

summary: The agent's solution is a minimal LightGBM baseline that correctly formulates the task and avoids data leakage. However, it completely lacks data cleaning, feature engineering, and robust validation (using only a single hold-out split and a single evaluation metric).
